Drive a rental car from Greer to Asheville on March 5, Asheville to Charlotte on March 7, Charlotte to Wilmington on March 10, and Wilmington to Greer on March 12. Retain the rental car for intercity travel, but park it and walk around downtown Asheville, Charlotte, and Wilmington where feasible. Use feasible entire-home accommodations in all three cities and retain both Wilmington nights, March 10 and 11. Visit Battleship North Carolina on March 11, schedule no more than one major attraction on each transfer day, favor local sit-down restaurants, and allow a quick-service meal during the return drive.
